## Describe the bug

A clear, concise description of what's wrong.

## Area

Which part of the project is affected?

- [ ] Backend pipeline (acquisition / processing / scripts)

- [ ] `geosat-mosaic-cesium` (3D globe viewer)
- [ ] `geosat-mosaic-openlayers` (2D map viewer)
- [ ] `geosat-gallery` (thumbnail viewer)
- [ ] Docs

## Steps to reproduce

1. ...
2. ...
3. See error / unexpected behavior

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen instead.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include console/log output if there's an error, warning, or traceback — the exact text is far more useful than a paraphrase.

## Screenshots / video

If applicable (especially for a frontend issue), add screenshots or a screen recording.

- Python version (backend issues):
